steps.title: Prepare ConA bead suspension
steps.instruction: Transfer 1.0 mL binding buffer into a 1.7 mL low‑bind tube, add 5 µL Con‑A beads per sample (5 µL for 100 k cells), vortex gently or flick to resuspend, and ensure beads are mixed thoroughly before pipetting.

steps.title: Homogenize and count cells
steps.instruction: Gently homogenize cells in a flask to obtain an even suspension, transfer 0.5 mL to a sterile Eppendorf tube, mix 10 µL of this cell suspension with 10 µL trypan blue, repeat for two replicates, place 10 µL from each mix on both sides of a Countess slide, count cells with the Countess/hemocytometer (ensure *Trypan blue corrected* is selected), calculate the average concentration, and confirm viability > 80 %.

steps.title: Pellet 100 k cells
steps.instruction: Transfer 100 k cells (as calculated) into a 15 mL centrifuge tube, spin at 600 × g for 3 min at room temperature, aspirate supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 1.0 mL room‑temperature Wash Buffer.

steps.title: Transfer to 2 mL tube
steps.instruction: Move the 1.0 mL cell suspension into a 2 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Bind cells to ConA beads (first magnet step)
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic stand for ~2 min until beads clear, remove supernatant while on the magnet, add 1.0 mL binding buffer, and resuspend thoroughly.

steps.title: Add fresh beads (second magnet step)
steps.instruction: Return the tube to the magnet, wait ~2 min for clearing, remove supernatant, add an equal volume of fresh Con‑A beads (5 µL per sample), and resuspend thoroughly.

steps.title: Incubate cells with beads
steps.instruction: Add the prepared bead mixture to the resuspended cells, vortex gently or flick to mix, and incubate at room temperature on a rotator for 10 min.

steps.title: Prepare antibody dilutions on ice
steps.instruction: While cells incubate, prepare antibody buffer (100 µL per sample) on ice, add primary antibodies at the recommended dilution (histone modifications 1:100; transcription factors 1:50–1:25), e.g., for 6 samples: 200 µL buffer + 2 µL primary Ab for each chromatin modification tube, 200 µL buffer + 4 µL primary Ab for each TF tube, and ensure digitonin is present for native cell permeabilization.

steps.title: Aliquot cells into tubes
steps.instruction: When incubation is complete, gently mix the cell‑bead suspension and divide equally into labeled 1.7 mL Eppendorf tubes using a wide‑bore pipette (e.g., for 6 samples, add 176 µL per tube; 0.6 mL tubes may be used).

steps.title: Wash cells – first spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 600 × g for 3 min, remove supernatant, add 1.0 mL Wash Buffer, and resuspend.

steps.title: Wash cells – second spin
steps.instruction: Perform a second centrifugation at 600 × g for 3 min, remove supernatant, add another 1.0 mL Wash Buffer, and resuspend. (For <100 k cells this second wash may be omitted.)

steps.title: Add primary antibody solution
steps.instruction: Place the tubes on a magnetic stand, allow beads to clear, then resuspend each tube in 100 µL of the prepared antibody solution, ensuring beads are homogenized by squirting the solution down the beads and gently flicking/tapping.

steps.title: Overnight antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the antibody‑bound tubes on a rotator in a cold room (4 °C) overnight (END DAY 1).

steps.title: Dilute pA/G‑MNase in Dig‑Wash
steps.instruction: Dilute epicypher pA/G‑MNase to 2 µL per reaction in 100 µL Dig‑Wash Buffer (e.g., for 6 samples: 600 µL Dig‑Wash + 12 µL MNase), keep on ice, quick‑spin tubes, place on magnet, clear, and discard supernatant.

steps.title: First Dig‑Wash washes
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL Dig‑Wash Buffer to each tube, flick to mix, place on magnet, clear, remove supernatant, and repeat once for a total of two washes (0.5 mL each).

steps.title: Add pA/G‑MNase reaction mix
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Dig‑Wash Buffer containing the diluted pA/G‑MNase to each tube, homogenize beads by flicking/tapping, briefly spin if needed, and incubate on a cold‑room rotator for 1 h.

steps.title: Post‑MNase Dig‑Wash washes
steps.instruction: Collect tubes, quick‑spin, place on magnet, clear, remove supernatant, then add 0.5 mL Dig‑Wash Buffer, flick, magnet, clear, remove supernatant, and repeat once more for a total of two additional washes.

steps.title: Add pA/G‑MNase reaction buffer
steps.instruction: Remove all liquid, quick‑spin, place tubes on a cold block, add 24 µL 1× pA/G‑MNase reaction mix to each tube, flick to mix, and start a 30‑min timer (use this time to prepare the 1× reaction mix).

steps.title: Add STOP buffer
steps.instruction: Add 8 µL 4× STOP buffer to each reaction by submerging the tip in the bead solution, flick/tap to mix, and spin down if necessary.

steps.title: Incubate to release fragments
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes in a 37 °C water bath for 30 min to release CUT&RUN fragments.

steps.title: Collect released DNA
steps.instruction: Place tubes on a magnetic stand until completely clear, then transfer 30 µL supernatant into new, labeled 0.6 mL tubes.

steps.title: Prepare ERA buffer mix
steps.instruction: For each sample, combine the amounts listed in the Meers lab 4× End‑Repair and A‑Tailing (ERA) buffer table (multiply by number of samples + 1), keep on ice until use.

steps.title: End‑repair and A‑tailing
steps.instruction: Place the DNA samples in a thermocycler pre‑cooled to 12 °C and run the program “CnR_ERA”.

steps.title: Dilute Y‑adapters
steps.instruction: While the thermocycler runs, retrieve the 1.5 µM TruSeq Y‑adapter from the 4 °C fridge, dilute 1:10 to obtain a 0.15 µM working solution (one tube per sample, avoid barcode overlap).

steps.title: Add adapters
steps.instruction: After the ERA program, remove samples from the thermocycler and add 5 µL of the appropriate diluted adapter to each sample.

steps.title: Prepare rapid ligase mix
steps.instruction: Per sample, mix 16 µL 5× Rapid Ligase Buffer, 4 µL Qiagen Rapid Ligase, and 20 µL Milli‑Q water to make 40 µL of 2× ligase solution (multiply by number of samples + 1).

steps.title: Ligate adapters
steps.instruction: Add 40 µL 2× rapid ligase solution to each sample, mix well by pipetting, place tubes in a thermocycler pre‑cooled to 20 °C, and run the program “CnR_Ligate”.

steps.title: Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: Collect the ligated tubes, add 2 µL 10 % SDS and 2 µL Proteinase K to each, and incubate in a 37 °C water bath overnight (END DAY 2).

steps.title: First Ampure cleanup
steps.instruction: Add 1.0× the sample volume of Ampure beads (e.g., 89 µL beads to 89 µL sample), mix by pipetting, incubate at room temperature for 5 min, place on a magnetic stand, remove supernatant, wash beads twice with 200 µL 80 % ethanol (30 s each), briefly spin, air‑dry beads 2–3 min, then add 50 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8 (no EDTA), incubate 5 min at room temperature, magnetically separate, and transfer eluate to new labeled 0.6 mL tubes.

steps.title: Second Ampure cleanup
steps.instruction: To the eluate, add 1.2× its volume of Ampure beads (e.g., 60 µL to 50 µL eluate), mix, incubate 5 min at room temperature, magnetically separate, wash twice with 200 µL 80 % ethanol (30 s each), air‑dry 2–3 min, add 25 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8, incubate 5 min, magnetically separate, and transfer 21 µL of the cleaned DNA to PCR tubes (excess volume prevents bead carry‑over).

steps.title: PCR amplification
steps.instruction: To each PCR tube add 2 µL Illumina F and R universal primers (final 0.4 µM each) and 25 µL 2× NEB Next Hot Start PCR Mastermix, then run the thermocycler program “CnR_14cycl”.

steps.title: Third Ampure cleanup
steps.instruction: Add 1.1× the PCR reaction volume of Ampure beads (e.g., 55 µL beads to 50 µL PCR product), mix, incubate 5 min at room temperature, place on magnet, remove supernatant, wash twice with 200 µL 80 % ethanol (30 s each), air‑dry 2–3 min, add 50 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8 (no EDTA), incubate 5 min, magnetically separate, and transfer eluate to new labeled 0.6 mL tubes.

steps.title: Fourth Ampure cleanup
steps.instruction: Add 1.2× the volume of beads to the eluate (e.g., 60 µL beads to 50 µL), mix, incubate 5 min at room temperature, magnetically separate, wash twice with 200 µL 80 % ethanol (30 s each), air‑dry 2–3 min, add 28 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8, incubate 5 min, magnetically separate, and transfer 25 µL of the final library into clean 1.7 mL tubes.

steps.title: Prepare streamlined reagents
steps.instruction: Before starting the experiment, prepare 5 % Digitonin Wash Buffer and Binding Buffer as described in the Meers lab protocol.

steps.title: Add ERA buffer to final samples
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL 4× ERA buffer to each 30 µL sample and mix by pipetting up and down.
